mapper.sql: id, order_id, user_id, merchant_id, driver_id, dish_id, rating_food, rating_delivery, rating_service, overall_rating, content, images, is_anonymous, merchant_reply, merchant_reply_time, status, create_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM review WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM review WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM review WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM review WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT r.id, r.order_id, r.user_id, r.merchant_id, r.driver_id, r.dish_id, r.rating_food, r.rating_delivery, r.rating_service, r.overall_rating, r.content, r.images, r.is_anonymous, r.merchant_reply, r.merchant_reply_time, r.status, r.create_time, r.update_time, r.deleted, u.username AS username, u.nickname AS user_nickname, u.avatar AS user_avatar FROM review r LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.user_id WHERE r.driver_id = #{driverId} AND r.deleted = 0 ORDER BY r.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review (id, order_id, user_id, merchant_id, driver_id, dish_id, rating_food, rating_delivery, rating_service, overall_rating, content, images, is_anonymous, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{orderId}, #{userId}, #{merchantId}, #{driverId}, #{dishId}, #{ratingFood}, #{ratingDelivery}, #{ratingService}, #{overallRating}, #{content}, #{images}, #{isAnonymous}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE review SET merchant_reply = #{merchantReply}, merchant_reply_time = #{merchantReplyTime}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE review SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.order_id, r.user_id, r.merchant_id, r.driver_id, r.dish_id, r.rating_food, r.rating_delivery, r.rating_service, r.overall_rating, r.content, r.images, r.is_anonymous, r.merchant_reply, r.merchant_reply_time, r.status, r.create_time, r.update_time, r.deleted, u.username AS username, u.nickname AS user_nickname, u.avatar AS user_avatar, m.shop_name AS shop_name, d.dish_name AS dish_name, d.dish_image AS dish_image FROM review r LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.user_id LEFT JOIN merchant m ON m.id = r.merchant_id LEFT JOIN dish d ON d.id = r.dish_id WHERE r.deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
